messages:
Elena G: Noting a docs break: the migration guide has mixed examples (some Python using model_name, some TS using model). Also our translated pages still mention /v1/embeddings.
Marcus D: Oof. Which pages?
Elena G: docs/migration.md and quickstarts/embeddings.md. I found the Spanish and Japanese translations under i18n that still reference v1.
Hiro N: Paste the offending snippets?
Elena G: Python streaming example uses `model_name` and old callback:
```python
for chunk in client.stream_response(model_name="redwood-pro", prompt="hi"):
    print(chunk.text)
```
TS example is correct but the embed cURL uses `/v1/embeddings`:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model_name":"embed-lite","input":"text"}'
```
Marcus D: Thanks. I'll open a single PR to normalize all examples to v2 and `model`, update cURL, and add a tiny compatibility shim section labeled clearly "temporary compatibility shim (remove after deprecation window)". PR 1901: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1901
docs-bot: lint: examples/embeddings.md -> deprecated path '/v1/embeddings' detected (rule: examples/paths).
Hiro N: Can we also update i18n pages? I can add a small note for translators and open backports for es/ja. i18n-bot: opened translation task #455 for es/ja updates.
Marcus D: Adding shim examples in both Python and TypeScript. Python shim:
```python
def generate_compat(client, **kwargs):
    if 'model_name' in kwargs and 'model' not in kwargs:
        kwargs['model'] = kwargs.pop('model_name')
    return client.generate(**kwargs)
```
TS shim:
```ts
function generateCompat(client, args) {
  if (args.model_name && !args.model) {
    args.model = args.model_name
    delete args.model_name
  }
  return client.generate(args)
}
```
Label: temporary; add caveats: not for long-term production, security review, and we will remove after the runtime grace period.
Elena G: Runtime confirmed a 10-day grace period. We'll emit Deprecation header and then return 422. Add that timeline to the deprecation notice block.
docs-bot: deploy-preview available for PR 1901: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/1901 (snippet-runner smoke tests included).
Hiro N: I pushed updated translated strings for es/ja and flagged the translators to review the wording about the shim. i18n-bot: translation draft created (task 455).
Marcus D: Also added a tiny automated snippet test verifying cURL and both SDK shims run against a mocked endpoint.
Elena G: LGTM. Merge when CI passes; follow up with a short announcement in #announcements and a redirect from old embed quickstart URL.
Marcus D: Will do. Thanks everyone.
